blocks.text: GUI computer program ke saath windows, buttons, menus, text boxes aur doosri graphical cheezon ke zariye kaam karne ka visual tareeqa hai.
Tkinter Python ki built-in library hai jis se desktop ke graphical user interfaces bante hain.
Window GUI application ki main screen ya container hai jis mein interface ki mukhtalif cheezein nazar aati hain.
Frame aik container hai jo GUI window ke andar widgets ko munazzam aur groups mein rakhta hai.
Widget GUI ka hissa hai, jaise label, button, entry field, menu ya listbox, jo maloomat dikhata ya user se input leta hai.
Event-driven programming aisa tareeqa hai jis mein program user ke events ya kaamon (jaise click) ka jawab deta hai.
Relational database data ko rows aur columns wale tables mein rakhta hai, aur mutalliq data keys ke zariye jura hota hai.
Structured Query Language (SQL) relational databases mein data banane, sambhalne aur badalne ki language hai.
Create operation database mein naye records dalta hai.
Read operation database se data nikalta aur dikhata hai.
Update operation database ke maujooda records badalta hai.
Delete operation database se records mehfooz tareeqe se mitata hai.

items: Tkinter GUIs: windows, frames, widgets, layout managers aur events.
Databases: tables aur keys, SQL, sqlite3 connection, CRUD.
